meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 按步骤给 NanoClaw 项目添加 DeltaChat 渠道：复制适配器文件、注册到频道列表、安装 @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server 依赖，并配置邮箱账号。完成后机器人就能通过 DeltaChat（基于电子邮件、带端到端加密）收发消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求把机器人接入 DeltaChat（如“加一个 DeltaChat 渠道”）时触发。执行前会先检查项目里是否已有该渠道的适配器文件和依赖，缺了才继续。

say.text: 帮我把 DeltaChat 渠道加到项目里。
say.note: 会先检查是否已添加，再执行安装步骤。

say.text: 我要让机器人能用 DeltaChat 收发消息。
say.note: 将开始安装适配器并配置邮箱账号。

say.text: 给机器人添加通过电子邮件加密收发消息的支持。
say.note: 对应 DeltaChat 渠道的集成。

howto.what_en: Adds DeltaChat to NanoClaw: copies the adapter and test, imports/registers it, installs @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server, and sets email credentials. The bot can then send and receive encrypted messages over DeltaChat.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a DeltaChat channel or enable DeltaChat messaging on the bot. It first checks if the adapter files and dependency already exist; if not, proceeds with installation.

say_en.text: Add the DeltaChat channel to the project.
say_en.note: Checks if it is already set up, then installs.

say_en.text: I want the bot to chat over DeltaChat.
say_en.note: Starts the adapter install and account setup.

say_en.text: Enable email-based encrypted messaging for the bot.
say_en.note: This is the DeltaChat channel integration.
